name: aasimar
special_features: Luminous hair, shimmering eyes, celestial aura
age: Same as humans, up to 160 years
lore:
To look upon an Aasimar is to witness a fragment of the heavens bound in mortal clay. They are the "Celestial-Touched," individuals whose very existence serves as a bridge between our mundane world and the sublime radiance of the Upper Planes.

**Appearance**
While they share the general silhouette of their mortal kin, Aasimar possess an ethereal quality that defies common biology. One might notice eyes that shimmer like molten gold or pupils that harbor the depth of a star-filled nebula. Their skin may carry a faint metallic luster—reminiscent of bronze, silver, or polished marble—and their hair often flows with an unnatural, luminous vitality. Above all, they project a palpable aura of "otherness," a stillness that commands the air around them and draws the eye of friend and foe alike.

**Origins**
An Aasimar’s heritage is rarely a matter of direct parentage; rather, it is a spiritual legacy. They are born from bloodlines once blessed by solar entities, or perhaps conceived during a rare cosmic alignment when the veil between worlds grew thin. They are not gods, but echoes of them—living conduits through which the ancient influence of benevolent planes leaks into the material realm.

**Culture**
The Aasimar experience is one of profound isolation and heavy duty. Most are raised in societies where they are viewed with either fearful reverence or dangerous envy. Many are haunted by "Guides"—celestial voices or visions that urge them toward paths of righteousness. Consequently, their culture is one of internal struggle. Some embrace their destiny as tireless defenders of the innocent, while others, overwhelmed by the impossible standards of their blood, attempt to dim their inner light and live in obscurity. They are a people of singular purpose, forever caught between the pull of the earth and the relentless call of the stars.
